results.notes: Run in the same wizard as TC-GEO-1260-007 (custom brand "Lictorix Geo", empty website field), market added: United States / English (EN) (step1). All values typed key by key (pressSequentially / keyboard). Step 2: "john@licter.com" typed with focus kept, then "Discover Categories" clicked directly: aria-invalid=true, field wrapper border red oklch(0.637 0.237 25.331), exact message "Enter a valid website, such as example.com.", still on Brand & Country, no discover-categories request (step2_when). Step 3 (focus kept all along, checked after each key): via select-all + Backspace then typing "licter.com" -> no error at "licter.com" (step2c); stricter variant from "john@licter.com" (error shown) deleting "john@" with Delete key by key -> no message, aria-invalid=false, no red border at "licter.com" while still focused (step2d). Detail: the error is in fact cleared on the first edit (already at "ohn@licter.com", still invalid) and is only re-evaluated on blur; it is therefore gone when the value becomes valid, as expected. Also, while the field is focused and invalid (before any edit), the focus border (rgb(3,105,161)) replaces the red border, the message staying visible. Step 4: "localhost" typed (no error while focused), field blurred -> red border + message shown again (step2e). Step 5: Backspace key by key while focused -> message and red border gone (already from the first Backspace); field empty and blurred -> no error, neutral border (step2f). Step 6: "Discover Categories" -> "Discovering Categories - Scanning how AI engines see Lictorix Geo across your markets." (step3_then_loading), request body entityName="Lictorix Geo", entityDomain=null, then Categories step: "We detected these categories for Lictorix Geo." with "Geospatial Analytics Software" and "Location Intelligence Platforms" (step3_then). Wizard exited with Back to Dashboard -> Exit and Discard (no analysis created).
